text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One is a downtown Edo girl from Oi. Some see her background as a regional racer as a weakness, but she's determined to make them eat their prejudices by blowing them away with her incredible racing skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her dream is to turn the Twinkle Series into a grand festival—a celebration where everyone will see her standing in the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals are her classmates Super Creek and Oguri Cap, and she eagerly awaits the day the three of them can light up a track together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We prepare for her upcoming competitions in every way, even bringing tatami mats into my office to better relax. Her once-in-a-lifetime chance at the Twinkle Series is about to begin!
